variants.title: Stitch refined: one screen, Screens tab
variants.description: Stitch direction as chosen by Christian, refined. The canvas shows only the open screen and gives it most of the room. One floating card on the left switches between Screens and Mockups with a segmented control (Screens active here). A floating vertical tool bar between the card and the screen holds Comment, Variants (with count), Inspect, Preview and More; the toolbar above the frame is gone. Top groups, right icon rail and zoom pill as in 1-stitch. Example data only.

variants.title: Stitch refined: one screen, Mockups tab
variants.description: Same layout as base with the card's segmented control on Mockups: the card lists the project's mockups (name, variant count) instead of the screens. The open screen, the side tool bar and all other chrome stay as they are; picking a mockup opens it on the canvas in place of the screen. Example data only.

variants.title: Stitch round 3: Screens tab
variants.description: Edited in place in round 3 (was round 2: agent bar, context tools in the tool bar, screen tree). Round 3 from Christian's comments: the tool bar is icon-only (52 px wide, 40 px buttons, aria-label per tool); a tool's name shows as a tooltip after the pointer rests on it for about 2 s (popover="hint" via interestfor, interest-delay-start: 2s; keyboard focus uses the same hint), shown here as a state example on Inspect. Variant rows in the screen tree carry the desktop/mobile icon of their viewport instead of a dot and show their own tags (compact chips, +N overflow). A tag toggle button sits next to the find field (aria-pressed, shown on) and shows or hides the tag chips in the list. Unchanged from round 2: Agent bar on the right, card down to the zoom pill's bottom edge, home expanded with default selected. Example data only.

variants.title: Stitch round 3: Mockups tab
variants.description: Edited in place in round 3 (was round 2: Mockups tab). Same chrome as base-v2 (icon-only tool bar, tag toggle next to the find field, Agent bar). On the Mockups tab only Comment and Comments are enabled; Inspect, Notes, Flow, Design system and More are greyed out (aria-disabled, label says "not available for mockups"). The canvas shows several mockup variants side by side: the three variants of the expanded mockup onboarding-ideas as frames in a row at 60%, each labelled with the mockup icon and "mockup title: variant title" (e.g. "Onboarding ideas: Guided tour"). The selected variant (guided-tour) has a teal ring and is highlighted in the list tree; variant rows use the mockup icon (mockups declare no viewport) and carry no tags, because mockup variants have none. Example data only.

variants.title: Stitch round 3: Board
variants.description: Board in the Stitch round 3 chrome. Board tab active; the left card stays because it carries the board filter (shared with the screen list) and the pins: filter "checkout" in the find field, a status line (5 on the board, Clear pins), the list grouped into Matches (3) and Pinned (2) with a pin button per row. The icon-only tool bar keeps the same tools and ids as on Screens; on the Board only Comment, Comments, Flow (shown pressed: flow arrows on) and More (clusters on/off, collapse all) are enabled, Inspect, Notes and Design system are greyed out (aria-disabled). The canvas shows each screen as a cluster: label (desktop/mobile icon, name, variant count, pin for pinned screens), the main frame and a row of micro thumbnails for its variants. Matches have a solid outline, screens pinned outside the filter a dashed teal outline. Flow arrows connect cart, checkout and order-placed; checkout carries the agent's write state, matching the Agent bar. All frames share one honest zoom (24%), the zoom pill offers zoom and Fit all. Example data only.

title: App UI refresh — Stitch direction refined
description: CHR-1257. Christian chose the Stitch direction (1-stitch in mockup ui-refresh). Round 1 (variants base, mockups-tab): the canvas shows exactly one screen, the open one; one floating card on the left switches Screens | Mockups; a floating vertical tool bar between the card and the screen; the toolbar above the frame is removed. Round 2 from Christian's comments (variants base-v2, mockups-tab-v2): the right icon rail is replaced by a slim, foldable Agent bar (live status with a Follow switch, activity feed newest first, note field for the agent), and the top-right group shrinks to settings; Notes, Comments (badge), Flow and Design system move into the left tool bar, which gets a grip and a fold control; Preview and Variants leave the tool bar; the Screens/Mockups card runs down to the zoom pill's bottom edge and scrolls inside; each row shows its tags and the desktop/mobile icon, variants are a collapsible tree. Round 3 from Christian's comments (base-v2 and mockups-tab-v2 edited in place, new variant board): the tool bar is icon-only, a tool's name appears as a tooltip after about 2 s of hover (shown on Inspect); variant rows carry the desktop/mobile icon and their tags; a tag toggle next to the find field shows or hides tag chips; tools that do not apply are greyed out (Mockups tab: only Comment and Comments; Board: Comment, Comments, Flow, More); the Mockups canvas shows several mockup variants side by side, labelled "mockup title: variant title"; the Board shows the filtered and pinned screens as clusters with flow arrows in the same chrome. base and mockups-tab stay unchanged as the anchors of the round 1 comments. Example data only. Not reviewed or approved yet.
